news.title: WE NEED YOUR SUPPORT!
news.body: LEAGUE OF NATIONS is coming soon! We are a tiny team, and you are how this game grows. Please follow us and share the game with your friends - it helps us more than you know. Thank you!

news.title: NEW UPDATE: ANCIENT EGYPT!
news.body:
54 new levels in 2 new worlds on the Nile: THE BUILDERS and RIDDLES. Tombs, cobras and golden keys. They start at level 217.

Also new:
- A new levels page
- A win screen for each world
- This inbox, with free skips

news.title: OPEN ANCIENT EGYPT NOW!
news.body: Don't want to wait? Invite 5 friends. When 5 of them install the game from your link, Egypt opens for you - starting at level 217. Or keep playing and reach it yourself.

news.title: TEŞEKKÜRLER TÜRKİYE!
news.body: EN BÜYÜK HAYRANLARIMIZ SİZSİNİZ! OYNADIĞINIZ, OYUNU PAYLAŞTIĞINIZ VE TÜM DESTEĞİNİZ İÇİN ÇOK TEŞEKKÜR EDERİZ. İYİ Kİ VARSINIZ!

news.title: ENJOYING CROSSBAR CHALLENGE?
news.body: If the game makes you smile, a short review on Google Play would mean a lot to us. It helps other players find the game and helps us make it better. Thank you for playing!

news.title: NEWS AND PRIZES ARE HERE
news.body: This is your new inbox. Our latest news and any prizes we give will show up here - no update needed. Tap the envelope on the menu any time.

prizes.title: A GIFT: 2 FREE SKIPS
prizes.body: Thanks for playing Crossbar Challenge. Stuck on a level? Press SKIP and use one - no ad.
